blocks.text: The following ODOT construction projects are anticipated to impact traffic in Jefferson County. All outlined work is weather permitting. Visit OHGO.com for travel updates or follow ODOT District 11 on Facebook or X for current Jefferson County construction information.

blocks.text: State Route 7 Projects
blocks.textContent: State Route 7 Projects

blocks.text: State Route 7 southbound lane closures north of Pottery Addition: November 23 - December 4, SR 7 southbound will be reduced to one lane from CR 56 to Pottery Addition for tree trimming work. Estimated Completion: December 4, 2026
blocks.textContent: State Route 7 southbound lane closures north of Pottery Addition: November 23 - December 4, SR 7 southbound will be reduced to one lane from CR 56 to Pottery Addition for tree trimming work. Estimated Completion: December 4, 2026

links.text: State Route 7 southbound lane closures north of Pottery Addition:

blocks.text: State Route 7 southbound 4 The SR 7 southbound on-ramp from 4th Street in Toronto is closed to traffic as part of a mine subsidence restoration project. To access SR 7 southbound, traffic is rerouted northbound to the SR 152 exit, then returns to SR 7 southbound. Estimated Completion: November 20, 2026.
blocks.textContent: State Route 7 southbound 4 The SR 7 southbound on-ramp from 4th Street in Toronto is closed to traffic as part of a mine subsidence restoration project. To access SR 7 southbound, traffic is rerouted northbound to the SR 152 exit, then returns to SR 7 southbound. Estimated Completion: November 20, 2026.

blocks.text: State Route 7 mine subsidence restoration: A mine subsidence restoration project on SR 7 just south of the 4th Street EXIT ramp in Toronto. One lane of traffic is maintained during construction. Estimated Completion: November 20, 2026
blocks.textContent: State Route 7 mine subsidence restoration: A mine subsidence restoration project on SR 7 just south of the 4th Street EXIT ramp in Toronto. One lane of traffic is maintained during construction. Estimated Completion: November 20, 2026

blocks.text: State Route 7 Northbound On-Ramp closure at Logan Avenue: The Logan Avenue ramp to SR 7 northbound is closed indefinitely due to a recurring slope failure. Since January 2025, the slope has repeatedly failed, prompting the ramp to be closed for safety until repairs can be made. Construction will begin in the coming months as ODOT awaits required approvals from the adjacent railroad. Estimated Completion: November 30, 2027

blocks.textContent: Other State Routes

blocks.text: State Route 152 closure north of Richmond: November 16-20: SR 152 will close north of CR 56. Buses and emergency services will be accommodated during that closure. All other traffic must detour during the closure times. Work hours are 7:30 AM-3 PM. The official detour is SR 43 south to U.S. 22 east, U.S. 22 east to SR 213 north, SR 213 north back to SR 152, and reverse.

blocks.text: Future dates will be shared as they become available.

blocks.text: The closures are necessary to replace cable. The closures will be at night to minimize the impact on the traveling public. Motorists should follow detour signs and use an alternate route. Emergency vehicles will be accommodated.
blocks.textContent: The closures are necessary to replace cable. The closures will be at night to minimize the impact on the traveling public. Motorists should follow detour signs and use an alternate route. Emergency vehicles will be accommodated.

blocks.text: Alternate Routes: Northbound traffic should use US 30 to East Liverpool, Ohio/Chester, WV, via the Jennings-Randolph Bridge, to WV 2 and Ohio 7. Southbound traffic should use Ohio 7 and WV 2 to Brilliant, Ohio, and Wellsburg, WV, onto the Wellsburg Bridge.
